summary: Texas Ventures Acquisition III Corp (TVA), a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting its entry into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Plus Automation, Inc. TVA will domesticate from Cayman Islands to Delaware and effect a double merger through two wholly owned subs, with Plus Automation surviving as a subsidiary. TVA stockholders will receive shares of the combined company. The transaction requires shareholder approvals of both TVA and Plus Automation and other closing conditions. No financial terms, valuation, or premium disclosed in excerpt. Watch for definitive proxy/registration statement with merger consideration and redemption estimates.
